title: John Alexander at Romanek's house: the flashlight answers questions

tellings.quote: "Well, we went in the backyard and he took the flashlight and he unscrews the flashlight till, you know, it's sort of on on off and it's off and puts them on the picnic table and then Roman starts asking questions and the flashlight starts asking the questions."

plain: In the backyard of a man named Stan Romanek's house in Colorado, a flashlight is said to have answered questions. John B. Alexander unscrewed it until it sat right on the edge between on and off, laid it on the picnic table, and then Romanek started asking questions and the flashlight responded. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels the story as Alexander told it to him, and it would mean some unseen intelligence was talking back through the light.
